Halite Gauntlet Cookie (Korean: 암염권갑 쿠키, am-yeomgwongab kuki, "Rock Salt Gauntlet Cookie") is a Legendary Cookie released alongside two Pets, her Epic Pet, Rocky and her Legendary Pet, Pangolith, in the first half of The Turmoil of Halite Monastery! update.

Story

The boundless Great Ramparts stretch so far that no lifetime is long enough to walk their length. Beyond them, past the sheer cliffs of the Halite Gorge, at a summit that scrapes the heavens, stands a sacred monastery no ordinary Cookie could hope to reach. At its gate, planted like a warning to the world, rests a legendary Spirit Weapon said to have seized the Ebony Dragon by the throat.

With a fist harder than stone and as massive as the tallest peaks, one strike can split ancient rocks in two. With but a single closed fist, even the Ebony Dragon could not find a way to slip free.

After the dragon's defeat, the gauntlets lay dormant deep within the Halite Monastery's armory... until, for reasons unknown, they took the form of a Cookie. The Cookie then proceeded to open the armory door herself. What followed was training for several lifetimes. Novice monks became elders, who then returned to the earth. And through each passing age, Halite Gauntlet Cookie never left the monastery grounds.

Now, as darkness gathers across the realm once more, Halite Gauntlet Cookie is ready to slam and clench her fists once more, shattering evil, and proving to the world that there is nothing she cannot protect.

Affection Jelly

Just when it is about to slip her mind, she dreams of leaving the Halite Monastery with her Master.

Skill

Halite Gauntlet Cookie's Skill
Summons an enormous phantom Gauntlet at certain intervals. Tap the attack button to swing the Gauntlet and destroy all surrounding obstacles and earn points. After using up all attack charges, she soars into the sky before delivering one last smash that slams into the ground and causes boulders to rise from the ground, devastating the surroundings. Level Up for more Gauntlet Swing Points and Gauntlet Slam Points.
LevelEnergy Skill
1182 Skill activates every 30 sec

Magic Candy
Gauntlet Slams create even more boulders. More additional points are granted based on the number of boulders that rise. The stronger the enchanted power, the higher the Gauntlet Slam Points.

Relationship Chart

  • Plum Cookie: There once was a time when I, too, would be overjoyed simply by punching a hole in a megalith...
    Friendly
  • Peach Cookie: Do not become arrogant. If you dutifully continue your training, you have the potential to save much of this world.
    Tension
  • White Peach Cookie: You are responsible for overcoming your own struggles. Do not entrust that duty to another Cookie.
    Tension
  • Obscure Umbra Cookie: One who taints the mortal world with countless evils... Just how do you intend to bear with the karmic consequences of your actions?
    Tension
  • Bamboo Blade Cookie: Your answer to even the harshest of struggles is a carefree smile... That smile may be the closest we get to echoing within the hearts of others.
    Trust
  • Nimbus Cake Cookie: There are as many struggles as there are Cookies within this realm. I never expected our training to lead us on similar paths.
    Friendly
  • Longjing Tea Cookie: The Tea Clan has deeply forged ties with the Halite Monastery. May that connection continue on for the distant future.
    Friendly
  • Xiaolongbao Cookie: He knows very well that Cookies must work together to protect this realm.
    Friendly

Appears On Relationship Charts

  • Plum Cookie: Stand unwavering in the face of challenges! Will I ever be as strong as you...?
    Trust
  • Peach Cookie: Do you really have to be so serious all the time when you're training?
    Friendly
  • General Jujube Cookie: Warrior, monk... Why should the title matter so long as we can save as many Cookies as possible?
    Trust
  • Leek Cookie: She wasn't too harsh in the time I took refuge at the Halite Monastery.
    Friendly
  • Obscure Umbra Cookie: You can hardly bear the burden of supporting a crumbling monastery... And yet you believe you will be able to protect this land?
    Tension
  • White Peach Cookie: She's so busy just leisurely training at that monastery of hers I doubt she'd even notice if I released poison there!
    Tension
  • Bamboo Blade Cookie: She has stood firm and protected us since a time long, long ago.
    Trust
  • Nimbus Cake Cookie: I took you for nothing more than an arrogant and rigid Spirit Weapon... But I see that you have walked a hard and rigorous path.
    Friendly
  • Longjing Tea Cookie: Powerful and resilient. I would love to take the time to learn from you... but I do not think time will allow it... *COUGH!*
    Trust
  • Xiaolongbao Cookie: I'm all for the fighting against yourself kinda thing, but I wouldn't mind learnin a thing or two from you either!
    Trust

Changelog

  • Summer Party at Marine Soda Bay! - June 26, 2026
    • Fixed an issue where travel distance varied depending on how the attack button was used.
    • Fixed an issue where Copper Coins appearing in The Beginning of a Legend's maps were not automatically collected.
  • The Turmoil of Halite Monastery! - April 30, 2026
    • Added to the game as a playable Cookie alongside a Costume,  Forged in the Mountain.
  • Bittersweet Awakening - January 14, 2026
    • Appears in the Bittersweet Awakening story.

Trivia

  • Peach Cookie's Relationship Chart can be unlocked by placing Halite Gauntlet Cookie on the Boundless Great Ramparts Lobby Design.
  • Halite Gauntlet Cookie is the second Spirit Weapon Cookie to be added to OvenBreak, and was released to coincide with the start of Season 11 and the release of the new Breakout episode centered on the Land of Martial Tarts.
  • Halite Gauntlet Cookie is the first Legendary Cookie to be released alongside her Legendary Pet on the same update.
    • She is also the first Cookie to have their Epic Pet and Legendary Pet be released on the same update.
  • Halite Gauntlet Cookie is the first Legendary Cookie to not have #Flight.
